policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: In two matches Southwest Baptist have outscored more than half the conference put together: Lewis, Lincoln, Maryville, Illinois Springfield, Indianapolis, McKendree, Missouri-St. Louis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have fewer goals between them.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Southwest Baptist have won both matches without conceding and open conference play at home to Missouri-St. Louis.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Seven matches are score gaps, finals with no published score, and all seven are dated before the earliest published result.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Missouri S&T have won both their matches, scoring seven and conceding once, and the one match past its date with no published result is theirs, away at Kentucky Wesleyan.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Upper Iowa have drawn both their matches, scoring once and conceding once, and play in the conference's opening match, away at Missouri S&T.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Rockhurst have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and their two defeats have come at Fort Hays State and at home to Rogers State.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Indianapolis have scored once and conceded once across a win, a draw and a defeat; Rick Lammerts has made eight saves and been beaten once.
